summary: Software Engineer with 1+ year of experience building scalable distributed systems and production-grade SaaS platforms used by 3M+ users globally.
detailedSummary:
I am a Software Engineer with over a year of hands-on experience at a high-growth product company, Darwinbox, where I have contributed to building scalable distributed systems and production-grade SaaS platforms used by millions of users. My work primarily involves designing efficient backend & frontend services, developing RESTful APIs, and optimizing system performance. I am proficient in Python, Java, C++, and JavaScript, and I take pride in writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code that aligns with real-world business needs.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and Engineering, where I developed a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented design, and system architecture. During my academic journey, I actively worked on impactful projects which strengthened my problem-solving skills and practical understanding of software engineering.

Throughout my career, I have demonstrated the ability to collaborate with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to deliver high-quality and reliable solutions. My goal is to continue growing as a software engineer by working on large-scale systems, solving complex engineering challenges, and contributing to innovative products that create meaningful impact. I am particularly driven to deepen my expertise in system design, distributed computing, and building robust platforms that scale efficiently.
